image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a salad dish featuring dark green leafy vegetables (possibly spinach or chard), sliced red strawberries with visible seeds, and a glossy, dark brown liquid drizzled over the ingredients. The sauce appears thick and viscous, pooling slightly on the white plate and coating the leaves. There are also hints of black structural elements, possibly part of the plating or utensil, intersecting the frame.
